tier_1.name: Immediate Hazard
tier_1.global_instruction: STOP. Biohazard or fire risk detected. Do not handle manually.

tier_2.name: Special Handling
tier_2.global_instruction: Divert to electronics recycling. Do not process with standard recyclables.

tier_3.name: Non-Hazardous Contaminant
tier_3.global_instruction: Material diversion required. Items are safe but incorrectly sorted.

tier_4.name: Clean Recyclable
tier_4.global_instruction: Purity verified. Material is ready for automated processing.

disposal_guidance.Battery: Flammable hazard. Tape terminals and dispose at a Household Hazardous Waste (HHW) center.
disposal_guidance.Biological: Infection risk. Use PPE and dispose in a red biohazard bag.
disposal_guidance.Medical Waste: Sharp/Infection risk. Place in a puncture-resistant Sharps container.
disposal_guidance.E-waste: Contains heavy metals. Drop off at a certified electronics recycler.
disposal_guidance.Cable: Tangling hazard for sorting machinery. Bundle and recycle as e-waste.
disposal_guidance.Clothes: Not for curbside bins. Donate to charity or drop at a textile recycling bank.
disposal_guidance.Shoes: Not for curbside bins. Donate if wearable or recycle at a specialized facility.
disposal_guidance.Trash: Non-recyclable. Dispose of in the standard landfill bin.
disposal_guidance.Can: Rinse out liquids and place in the metal recycling stream.
disposal_guidance.Cardboard: Flatten boxes and ensure they are free of food grease/oil.
disposal_guidance.Glass: Rinse and separate by color if required by local guidelines.
disposal_guidance.Metal: Valuable scrap. Ensure it is free of hazardous attachments.
disposal_guidance.Paper: Keep dry. Do not include shredded paper unless bagged.
disposal_guidance.Plastic: Check resin codes (1-7). Rinse and remove plastic film/wraps.
